in_sanskrit.name: बलभद्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: बल (bal) - strength, भद्र (bhadra) - friend, pleasing. Balabhadra is a name of Lord Balarama, who is the elder brother of Lord Krishna.

in_marathi.name: Balabhadra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balabhadra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balabhadra is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'bringer of happiness, powerful, and auspicious'. This name is associated with Lord Balarama, who is an avatar of Lord Vishnu and the elder brother of Lord Krishna in Hindu mythology.
